title: `NoiseTexture2D.get_image()` returns shared instance of image
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in v4.8.dev.custom_build [370b75903] ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (370b75903) - macOS Tahoe (26.5.1) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M4 Pro - Apple M4 Pro (14 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description The [documentation for `Texture2D.get_image()`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_texture2d.html#class-texture2d-method-get-image) states that it > Returns an [Image](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_image.html#class-image) that is a copy of data from this Texture2D (a new [Image](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_image.html#class-image) is created each time) However, this is not true for the `NoiseTexture2D` subclass. If `NoiseTexture2D.get_image()` is used to get the texture's image, and that image is resized, then the return result from a second call to `get_image()` also returns the resized image. --- This issue was reported by user henrikfalk on the Godot Engine Discord server. ### Steps to reproduce An MRP has the following node tree setup and script: ```gdscript extends Control @onready var tr1: TextureRect = %FirstImage func _ready(): await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout var scatter_noise: NoiseTexture2D = tr1.texture print("ScatterNoise size: %s" % scatter_noise.get_size()) var img1: Image = scatter_noise.get_image() print("Image 1 size: %s" % img1.get_size()) var img2: Image = scatter_noise.get_image() print("Image 2 size: %s" % img2.get_size()) print("Now resizing only image 2...") img2.resize(512, 512) print("New Image 1 size (should be same): %s" % img1.get_size()) print("New Image 2 size (should be resized): %s" % img2.get_size()) ``` The printed results are: ``` ScatterNoise size: (256.0, 256.0) Image 1 size: (256, 256) Image 2 size: (256, 256) Now resizing only image 2... New Image 1 size (should be same): (512, 512) New Image 2 size (should be resized): (512, 512) ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) The below project contains the same example as is described above. [test-noise-texture-2d-image_2026-07-10_09-10-46.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29897271/test-noise-texture-2d-image_2026-07-10_09-10-46.zip)
